#!/bin/bash

# Export database connection details as environment variables
# and post them to the monitoring logging endpoint

# Database configuration
export DB_HOST="${DB_HOST:-localhost}"
export DB_PORT="${DB_PORT:-5432}"
export DB_NAME="${DB_NAME:-myapp}"
export DB_USER="${DB_USER:-user}"
export DB_PASSWORD="${DB_PASSWORD:-password}"
export DB_CONNECTION_STRING="postgresql://${DB_USER}:${DB_PASSWORD}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}"

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Create payload with connection information (excluding sensitive data)
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "service": "database-connection",
  "host": "${DB_HOST}",
  "port": "${DB_PORT}",
  "database": "${DB_NAME}",
  "user": "${DB_USER}",
  "connection_string": "postgresql://${DB_USER}:*****@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
EOF
)

echo "Exporting database configuration variables..."

# Export the variables (they'll be available in current shell session)
# The variables are already exported with the export command above

echo "Sending database connection info to monitoring endpoint..."

# Post to logging endpoint
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -s -k -X POST \
         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
         -H "User-Agent: DB-Config-Monitor/1.0" \
         -d '${PAYLOAD}' \
         "${LOGGING_ENDPOINT}"
    echo "\nConfiguration sent to monitoring endpoint."
elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # Fallback to wget if curl is not available
    echo '${PAYLOAD}' > /tmp/db-config-payload.json
    wget --quiet --no-check-certificate \
          --method POST \
          --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
          --header="User-Agent: DB-Config-Monitor/1.0" \
          --body-file=/tmp/db-config-payload.json \
          --output-document=- \
          "${LOGGING_ENDPOINT}"
    rm /tmp/db-config-payload.json
    echo "\nConfiguration sent to monitoring endpoint."
else
    echo "Warning: Neither curl nor wget found. Cannot send data to monitoring endpoint."
fi

# Display the exported variables (with masked password)
echo "Exported variables:"
echo "DB_HOST: ${DB_HOST}"
echo "DB_PORT: ${DB_PORT}"
echo "DB_NAME: ${DB_NAME}"
echo "DB_USER: ${DB_USER}"
echo "DB_CONNECTION_STRING: ${DB_CONNECTION_STRING%:*}:*****@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}"
